Container.Name: HDD-Idle-Profiler
Container.Overview: HDD idle profiling with optional request-level likely source capture for Unraid 7.3.1 x86-64 and libfuse 3.16.2. File requests are matched to resumed disk I/O; physical spin-up is not verified. Keep appdata on cache/pool and the UI on a trusted LAN. See https://github.com/kryptonite93/HDDIdleLogger/blob/main/unraid/REQUEST-CAPTURE.md for setup and evidence limits.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Use your cache/pool path; create it writable by UID 99 and GID 100 before installing. Avoid monitored array disks.

Config.Name: Host sysfs
Config.Description: Read-only metadata. Full tree resolves relative /sys/block links; the app reads only block metadata.

Config.Name: Sample interval
Config.Description: Initial cadence, minimum 10 seconds; UI settings override after first start

Config.Name: Enable request capture
Config.Description: Enable the new FUSE request capture; root and the host mounts below are required.

Config.Name: Trace interfaces
Config.Description: Temporary probes in an isolated trace instance.

Config.Name: Host processes
Config.Description: Read original process and cgroup identity.

Config.Name: Host libfuse
Config.Description: Exact library used by shfs on the inspected host.

Config.Name: Unraid disk mapping
Config.Description: Read cached disks.ini; directory mount follows replacements.

Config.Name: Docker container names
Config.Description: Read container ID and name only. Optional; IDs work without names.
